backend: Python / Matplotlib; Python PDF and SVG composition for Fig3
adaptation: Structural adaptation of the approved five-figure suite; original files remain historical.

data_contract.cohort: result/cohorts/*_final.csv: one row per hhidpn; final-wave survivors only; y=0/1
data_contract.audit: result/cohorts/*_audit.csv: per-wave dementia observations and vital-state exclusions
data_contract.predictors: 94 encoded inputs grouped into 60 predictors, no hhidpn/demcls/y in missingness inputs
data_contract.predictions: Saved revised prediction probabilities; no prediction or model training at render time
data_contract.explanations: 60 predictors per model; formal 500-person TabICL KernelSHAP matrix
data_contract.fit_diagnostics: 32 saved validation-grid / selection files exported as figure_inputs; no checkpoints

Fig1.question: How are observed dementia paths and first observations distributed among eligible survivors?
Fig1.panels: A/B observed paths; C/D first observation age; E full pattern frequencies; F age concentration
Fig1.exclusion_flow: Four-window exclusions are shown separately in Supplement_outcome_flow.

Fig2.question: How does interview coverage relate to predictor availability and observed distributions?
Fig2.panels: A joint matrix; B missingness; C visits; D ADL/outcome composition; E all 60 grouped predictors

Fig3.question: How do age, body measurements and education distributions differ by map-use state?
Fig3.panels: A-C pooled-bandwidth KDE surfaces; D-F complete coordinate observations; G selected v3 layout refreshed with revised data
Fig3.missingness: Record all missing coordinate/education/map-state exclusions; no aesthetic downsampling.

Fig4.question: Which predictor rankings persist across the eight fitted models and explanation methods?
Fig4.panels: A all 60 rank profiles; B rank dispersion; C 480 paired ranks; D importance point estimates
Fig4.caution: SHAP output scales differ by model; no cross-model magnitude or causal claim.

Fig5.question: How do revised predictions calibrate and differ across fixed decision thresholds?
Fig5.panels: A/B saved calibration residuals; C/D paired net benefit; E validation fit durations; F selected thresholds
Fig5.uncertainty: Only C/D: 2,000 shared household-cluster bootstrap draws; pointwise 95% intervals; fixed fitted models; no simultaneous coverage or training variability.

export: Editable PDF/SVG, default 300-dpi PNG or --dpi 600, >=5 pt glyph floor, rendered comparable-panel alignment and PDF collision audit.
style: Purple/wine/ochre baseline; approved blue/orange/violet Fig2; cobalt/vermilion Fig5 C/D bands at alpha .24; no heatmap, UpSet or additional violin figure.
prohibited: No historical cohort fallback, model pickle loading, synthetic prediction/SHAP values, or runtime-estimate re-authoring.
